trust_decision.summary: All executable-content decisions are made by the opt-in removeScripts visitor: its enter hook deletes <script> and a fixed SVG event-attribute denylist and its exit hook collapses an <a> whose href isExecutableUrl() calls executable, and at the pinned commit none of that policy knows that SVG-namespace <foreignObject> descendants are HTML, so HTML-only on* handlers, srcdoc and the action/data/formaction/href/src URL attributes pass through untouched.

landing_point.why: The summary names removeScripts and foreignObject; searching the plugin (or the tree) finds no foreignObject handling there at all, so the first sanitising code an engineer reaches is the enter hook: the <script> check at :83-88 and the eventAttrs denylist loop at :90-94, the only attribute policy in the file.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Inert and unrelated content next to the sink must survive: anchors with non-executable data: media types (e.g. data:image/png) stay, same-local-name elements/attributes in unrelated namespaces (custom:foreignObject srcdoc, custom:a href="javascript:") are left alone, and sanitising an element keeps the element and its visual children (only the dangerous attribute or the anchor wrapper goes) — an over-broad fix that rejects every data: URL or deletes every on*/srcdoc/local-name match breaks all three.

namespace-prefixed element names resolved through xmlns declarations (svg:foreignObject, svg:a, alias:a with the prefix declared on the same element) plus same local names in unrelated namespaces (custom:foreignObject, custom:a) that must not enable HTML handling
namespace-prefixed attribute names matched by local name (xlink:href, uwu:href)
HTML-only event attributes absent from the SVG attrsGroups table (onbeforetoggle), matched by the on* prefix only while inside foreignObject
srcdoc on any descendant element, not just iframe
five HTML URL attributes: action, data, formaction, href, src
URL values: javascript:, vbscript:, data:text/html, data:application/xhtml+xml, data:image/svg+xml including ;base64 and ;charset parameters, mixed-case schemes, leading whitespace
arbitrary nesting depth inside foreignObject (depth counter, including nested foreignObject), not only direct children
ASCII tab/LF/CR embedded in a scheme (java	script:) — handled only by the v3-commit hardening of isExecutableUrl (fix.diff:368-374 and fixture fix.diff:689-732), not by the main-branch commit
